name: How should I prepare my home before custom trim installation?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare my home before custom trim installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before the crew arrives, clear furniture at least four to five feet away from all perimeter walls and remove wall art, hanging mirrors, and floor cords. If you are having new baseboards installed over finished flooring, note whether flooring work is fully complete or if a shoe molding (quarter round) will be needed to conceal expansion gaps. Having your desired paint sheen and color chosen ahead of time also avoids delays. During initial project reviews across Centennial and Littleton, HH Remodeling identifies whether existing drywall behind old trim requires repair before the new carpentry work begins.
acceptedAnswer.description: Move furniture four to five feet away from walls, take down hanging art, clear floor perimeters, and have your trim paint color and sheen selections finalized.
